SUTR-2 — SUCA

The SuperUnicode Collation Algorithm.

Collation is the ordering contract for SuperUnicode strings. SUCA is now a full UCA(UTS #10)-equivalent multilevel algorithm, formally specified by SUTS-001 and implemented by the freestanding suts_suca reference.

  • Multilevel — L1 (base), L2 (accent), L3 (case), L4 (variable), identical (NFD codepoint tie-break).
  • Canonical equivalence — input is NFD-normalized before mapping (e.g. role < rôle < roles, and precomposed ≈ decomposed).
  • Contractions & expansions — e.g. c h as one letter; œ ≈ oe.
  • Variable weighting — shifted (default), blanked, non-ignorable, shift-trimmed; SCP controls ignorable at L1–L3.
  • Backward secondary — French dictionary order.
  • Implicit weights — Unassigned/Han/Native/plugin codepoints get algorithmic primaries from the 64-bit codepoint (monotonic; plugin space above Base).

The complete normative algorithm, weight scheme, data files and conformance matrix are in SUTS-001 — SuperUnicode Collation Algorithm.

Data: Public/0.1.0/collation/SUCA.txt (Base) and collation/ExtUCA.txt (Extended) — both extSUCS-compatible.
